basis: Thiamine deficiency causing peripheral neuropathy defines dry beriberi; cardiac involvement defines the wet form.
Disordered sleep regulation is neurologic dysfunction; this heterogeneous umbrella establishes no common damage to other organs.
Inherited TGFBI-related dystrophy directly affects the cornea.
Inflammation of the iris and anterior chamber is generally immune-mediated or infectious; associated systemic diseases are separate diagnoses.
Generalized reflex epilepsy; eyelid myoclonia and photosensitivity are seizure manifestations, not eye damage.
Severe intellectual disability, microcephaly and spondylometaepiphyseal dysplasia define the syndrome; hair texture changes do not establish skin damage.
Corneal and conjunctival inflammation; the umbrella includes infectious, immune, exposure and neurotrophic causes, so no common mechanism axis applies.
Progressive sensory and motor neuron degeneration; muscle atrophy and dysphagia reflect denervation rather than independent muscle or gastrointestinal disease.
Congenital muscular dystrophy with common developmental impairment; cardiac conduction disease affects >30% over time. Respiratory weakness reflects muscle disease.
The named syndrome defines cardiac, pulmonary venous and CNS malformations; pulmonary venous abnormalities are cardiovascular, without documented lung damage.
Combined carcinoma originates in the lung; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine disease.
Neoplasm of the buccal mucosa; oral mucosa belongs to the gastrointestinal axis.
Fluid accumulation directly impairs pulmonary gas exchange; underlying heart failure is a separate causal disease.
Radiation-induced damage to peripheral nerves defines this disease.
Acute myeloid leukemia affects myeloid blood cells and marrow; the CEBPA mutation does not establish additional organ involvement.
Primary osteonecrosis directly destroys bone; impaired perfusion does not itself establish a separate vascular disorder.
Congenital unilateral duplication of a biphalangeal thumb is a structural skeletal abnormality.
Peripheral corneal ulceration, typically immune-mediated marginal keratitis from hypersensitivity to bacterial antigens.
Neurodegeneration classified under brain iron metabolism disorders; supranuclear gaze palsy and muscle stiffness are neurologic manifestations.
Failure of marrow blood-cell production defines the umbrella; additional congenital abnormalities vary across subtypes.
Developmental impairment and CNS hypomyelination define disease; visual loss is cerebral. Single-patient cardiac and skeletal findings do not establish >=30% prevalence.
Chronic mast-cell-mediated urticarial skin disease; recurrent wheals are the defining disease manifestation.
Defecatory outlet dysfunction causes persistent bowel evacuation impairment; no independent muscle or nerve disease is established.
Marrow failure syndrome; microcephaly in 3/7 (~43%) supports brain involvement. Anal atresia 2/7 (~29%) is borderline and omitted; pigment spots are nondamaging; cancers are separate.
Developmental impairment, limb abnormalities and eczema define syndrome; dental abnormalities occur in 80-99%. Blue sclerae do not establish eye damage; IgG2 deficiency frequency is unclear.
